context: Sho-young plays with a small dog; tells Mei about the moment.
purpose: Child sharing simple joy with mother.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さん、犬、見たよ、お出かけで!
lines.en: Mom, we saw a dog on our outing!
lines.style: Breathless excitement. Words tumble out fast. Bright, warm delivery—the kind that makes adults smile. Open vowels. Pure, unselfconscious joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Oh, was it a cute dog?
lines.style: Gentle, engaged attention. Leans in slightly—this matters because it matters to him. Soft vowels, warm underneath. The tone of someone truly listening, not waiting to respond.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 素早く、走って、まねできなかった!
lines.en: It ran so fast—I couldn't keep up!
lines.style: Wonder mixed with just a hint of breathlessness. Eyes wide on 「速く」. Soft awe rather than frustration. The delight of witnessing something he couldn't match.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Was its tail wagging the whole time?
lines.style: Soft, playful curiosity. Almost conspiratorial—she's matching his energy but gently. Warm smile underneath. Drawing him deeper into the memory together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I could really feel how much love it had.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine observation. No performance. The kind of thing a child says that stops you. Soft exhale. Content and thoughtful, not asking for validation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆と楽しく、過ごせて、良かったね。
lines.en: It's so good that you got to spend the whole time together having fun.
lines.style: Tender, reflective. Not saccharine. She's mirroring back what he's given her—the wholeness of the moment. Slow pace. Warmth that lives in the pauses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It really was so much fun!
lines.style: Final flourish of joy—less frantic than the opening, more settled. A contented echo. Still bright, but with the gentle tiredness of a child at the end of a perfect day.
